<documents>
<document id="security-fraud-alerts">
HowˆfraudˆalertsˆworkˆWhenˆweˆseeˆaˆcardˆtransactionˆthatˆlooksˆunusual,ˆweˆdeclineˆitˆandˆsendˆyouˆaˆfraudˆalertˆinˆtheˆapp,ˆandˆbyˆtextˆifˆyou'veˆturnedˆthatˆon.ˆ##ˆAnsweringˆanˆalertˆTheˆalertˆshowsˆtheˆmerchant,ˆamountˆandˆlocation.ˆTapˆ"Yes,ˆthatˆwasˆme"ˆorˆ"No,ˆthatˆwasn'tˆme".ˆ-ˆ**Yes:**ˆtheˆcardˆisˆunlockedˆstraightˆaway.ˆTryˆtheˆpurchaseˆagain.ˆ-ˆ**No:**ˆtheˆcardˆstaysˆlocked.ˆWe'llˆguideˆyouˆthroughˆreportingˆitˆandˆdisputingˆanyˆotherˆcharges.ˆ##ˆIfˆyouˆdon'tˆanswerˆIfˆyouˆdon'tˆanswerˆwithinˆ24ˆhours,ˆtheˆcardˆstaysˆlockedˆuntilˆyouˆcontactˆus.ˆ##ˆIsˆthisˆalertˆreal?ˆRealˆalertsˆappearˆinsideˆtheˆTallowbrookˆapp.ˆAˆtextˆalertˆonlyˆeverˆasksˆyouˆtoˆreplyˆYESˆorˆNO,ˆandˆneverˆcontainsˆaˆlink.ˆWeˆneverˆaskˆforˆyourˆcardˆnumber,ˆPIN,ˆpasswordˆorˆaˆone-timeˆcodeˆtoˆconfirmˆanˆalert.ˆIfˆsomeoneˆcallsˆyouˆaboutˆaˆfraudˆalert,ˆhangˆupˆandˆopenˆtheˆappˆinstead.ˆ##ˆTooˆmanyˆalerts?ˆAlertsˆareˆmoreˆcommonˆwhenˆyouˆshopˆsomewhereˆnewˆorˆabroad.ˆTheyˆgetˆlessˆfrequentˆasˆourˆsystemsˆlearnˆyourˆpatterns.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="check-deposit-how">
DepositingˆaˆcheckˆinˆtheˆappˆYouˆcanˆdepositˆpaperˆchecksˆbyˆtakingˆaˆphotoˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆ##ˆHowˆtoˆdepositˆ1.ˆSignˆtheˆbackˆofˆtheˆcheck.ˆ2.ˆUnderˆyourˆsignature,ˆwriteˆ"ForˆmobileˆdepositˆonlyˆatˆTallowbrook".ˆ3.ˆTapˆTransfers,ˆthenˆDepositˆaˆcheck.ˆ4.ˆEnterˆtheˆamountˆandˆphotographˆtheˆfrontˆandˆbackˆonˆaˆdarkˆsurface.ˆ##ˆLimitsˆ|ˆPlanˆ|ˆDailyˆmobileˆcheckˆdepositˆlimitˆ|ˆ|---|---|ˆ|ˆBasicˆ|ˆ$1,000ˆ|ˆ|ˆPlusˆ|ˆ$2,500ˆ|ˆ|ˆPremiumˆ|ˆ$5,000ˆ|ˆ##ˆKeepˆtheˆcheckˆKeepˆtheˆpaperˆcheckˆforˆ14ˆdaysˆafterˆit'sˆdeposited,ˆthenˆdestroyˆit.ˆDon'tˆdepositˆtheˆsameˆcheckˆanywhereˆelse.ˆ##ˆChecksˆweˆcan'tˆacceptˆChecksˆmadeˆoutˆtoˆsomeoneˆelse,ˆchecksˆfromˆoutsideˆtheˆUS,ˆmoneyˆorders,ˆandˆchecksˆwithoutˆtheˆendorsementˆabove.ˆ##ˆWhenˆtheˆmoneyˆisˆavailableˆSeeˆ"Whenˆcheckˆdepositsˆareˆavailable".ˆTheˆappˆshowsˆtheˆreleaseˆdateˆafterˆyouˆsubmitˆtheˆdeposit.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="docs-verification-letter">
AccountˆverificationˆletterˆAnˆaccountˆverificationˆletterˆconfirmsˆthatˆyouˆhaveˆanˆopenˆaccountˆwithˆus.ˆLandlords,ˆemployersˆandˆgovernmentˆofficesˆsometimesˆaskˆforˆone.ˆ##ˆGetˆaˆletterˆTapˆProfile,ˆthenˆDocuments,ˆthenˆAccountˆverificationˆletter.ˆTheˆPDFˆisˆreadyˆrightˆawayˆandˆshowsˆyourˆname,ˆaccountˆnumber,ˆaccountˆtypeˆandˆtheˆdateˆtheˆaccountˆwasˆopened.ˆ##ˆShowingˆyourˆbalanceˆYouˆcanˆchooseˆwhetherˆtheˆletterˆincludesˆyourˆcurrentˆbalance.ˆ##ˆCustomˆlettersˆWeˆcan'tˆwriteˆcustomˆletters,ˆsignˆforms,ˆorˆfillˆinˆthird-partyˆverificationˆforms.ˆTheˆstandardˆletterˆisˆacceptedˆbyˆmostˆorganizations.ˆ##ˆClosedˆaccountsˆLettersˆareˆonlyˆavailableˆforˆopenˆaccounts.ˆForˆaˆclosedˆaccount,ˆuseˆyourˆfinalˆstatement.ˆ##ˆSomeoneˆelseˆaskingˆWeˆdon'tˆconfirmˆaccountˆdetailsˆtoˆlandlords,ˆemployersˆorˆanyoneˆelseˆwhoˆcontactsˆusˆdirectly.ˆGiveˆthemˆtheˆletterˆyourself.ˆ##ˆIsˆitˆofficial?ˆYes.ˆTheˆletterˆcarriesˆaˆverificationˆcodeˆthatˆtheˆrecipientˆcanˆcheckˆonˆourˆhelpˆcenter.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
</documents>
